title: No room, no release: a queued entry whose Pearl tier's swarm has no slot waits at its source instead of being made as a dot cloud (the yellow and green dot clouds of a huge sector-9 wave)
context: Owner, 2026-10-14, playing the Pearl default: "sector 9, a huge wave of yellow and green old half-dotted enemies appeared." Each Pearl tier is one instanced swarm of PEARL_FOLLOW.capacity slots (white 3000, yellow 2000, blue 2000, orange 1000, green 1000, purple 800, brown 600, black 600; src/fx/creature-pearl.js take): past it the slot is refused (p.full), spawn returns false and src/fx/enemy-step.js spawnOne makes the record again as its own dot cloud (`undressed`, round two 2026-10-13, meant for a cage that failed to load). A late stampede wave of the yellow and green rungs exceeds those two capacities, so its tail came up as the old dot clouds. Measured headless to rule the rest out: sector 9 at wave 7, 1,757 records all dressed, every type mapped (PEARL_OF covers the fifteen), no undressed record; four cycles of 400 yellow bodies spawned and cleared leak no slot; the harness cannot spawn thousands fast enough (the crowd gate) to hit a capacity in a probe, so the capacity path is shown by reading, not reproduced.
outcome: src/fx/creature-pearl.js room(tier): the free heap plus the never-used tail of the capacity; src/fx/creature-bodies.js room(family, tier) (Infinity for a family that does not count); src/fx/creature-enemies.js full(entry): under the Pearl set, an entry of a mapped type (not one already made again as dots) whose tier has fewer slots than it needs (a squad needs one a member); src/fx/enemy-step.js releaseSpawns holds the queue on it exactly as on the crowd gate and an unready source (the entry put back at the clock, the loop breaks). The dot-cloud fallback stays as the last resort for a body that cannot be made at all. test/enemy-step.mjs: with a family that has no room nothing releases over 400 frames and nothing throws; with room the three release as before; the pinned behaviour hash unchanged. The harness state now carries `sounds` (every sound asked by key, src/audio.js played) and `achievements` (the run's), both added for this diagnosis and kept.
alternatives: Raise every tier's capacity to the crowd cap's 3,500: eight swarms' instance buffers allocated for it, for a tail that waits a few seconds at its mouth otherwise; the capacities stay the owner's fps knobs.
Keep the dot-cloud fallback: the owner's "we are adapting to the new enemies" rules the old bodies out of the story.
Drop the record instead of holding it: the wave would lose bodies the ladder planned.
evidence: the sector-9 probe (scratch): 1,757 dressed, 0 undressed at wave 7; the yellow cycle probe: 1,279 bodies through, 0 undressed
